title: Lodging at Old Faithful Yellowstone&Grand Teton Small Group 4-day
includes: Hot Breakfast on Day 2 through Day 4
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Avoid traveling in a different bus? If you have more than one booking, please provide all confirmation numbers once your bookings are complete. Room Details All hotel rooms are based on two Full / Double beds or one King/Queen bed depends on what hotel available on the day.
One Room Selection If you are a party of more than four guests or desire to have separate rooms, please provide a separate booking.
Age and Safety: Customers under 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Pregnant women may join if under 24 weeks by the trip's end.
Tickets and Charges: City Passes and personal attraction tickets are not accepted. Attraction prices may change, and tickets are non-refundable.

East Gate: Scheduled to open on 05/02/2025. Before this date, attractions like Upper and Lower Falls, Artist Point, Hayden Canyon, Mud Volcano, Fishing Bridge, and West Thumb Geyser will remain inaccessible. South Gate: Scheduled to open on 05/10/2025. West Thumb Geyser will not be accessible from 05/02/2025 to 05/09/2025. Thank you for your understanding during these seasonal openings.
Leaving the Group: If leaving the group early, inform the tour guide and sign a departure form. No refunds for unused portions.
Gifts and Refunds: Gifts provided during the tour may change due to unforeseen factors like weather. Fees will not be refunded for changes.

Hotels offer various room types, including King/Queen beds or two double twin beds, with a maximum occupancy of 2-4 people per room. Guests must present at least one valid credit or debit card at check-in, which will be refunded within 7-14 working days after check-out if there are no charges. Tour operator ensure room availability but cannot guarantee specific room types or locations. Check-in time typically begins after 15:00.
Closed Attractions: If a scenic spot is closed, an alternative will be provided. COVID-19 may affect attraction hours and capacity.
cancellation:
If you cancel at least 6 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.
If you cancel between 2 and 6 day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a 50% refund.
If you cancel within 2 day(s) of the scheduled departure, you will receive a 0% refund.
blurb: Experience Yellowstone the way it’s meant to be seen—with two exclusive nights inside the park at the iconic Old Faithful Snow Lodge. This in-depth small group tour is limited to just 13 guests and travels in a brand-new Mercedes-Benz high-top van, offering comfort, space, and a more personal experience. Led by professional guides, you’ll explore the very best of Yellowstone and Grand Teton National Parks, from legendary geysers and colorful hot springs to alpine lakes, dramatic canyons, and wildlife-rich valleys. Staying inside Yellowstone means less driving, fewer crowds, and more time at the park’s most iconic sights. With airport pickup, park entry fees, hot breakfasts, and a Yellowstone Bear World ticket included, every detail is handled—so you can fully relax and focus on the adventure.
